name: runtime_supervisor
description: Render, validate, install and verify the runtime supervisor's native user unit so every setup run converges it and the readiness phase re-inspects it.

storage.rationale: The safeguard writes only the invoking user's native scheduler unit and the supervisor log directory under the user's Vrooli home; it needs no privilege.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
